entries.conclusion: The official Sandalphon Q&A fixes turn-start order: crest effects resolve before Invocation; countdown destruction is collected before Invocation, its Last Words resolves after Invocation, and the ordinary turn draw is last.
entries.summary: 官方 Q&A 明确了纹章、倒数破坏、瞬念召唤、谢幕曲、瞬念后续能力和通常抽牌的回合开始顺序。

entries.conclusion: The official Balt Q&A says the opponent wins when both leaders are at 1 defense and the controller ends the turn with Balt's all-leader crest.
entries.summary: 官方 Q&A 明确巴尔特纹章在双方主战者均为 1 时由对手获胜，证明致死立即确定并停止剩余伤害。

entries.conclusion: The official card text identifies Marwynn's crest as a turn-end source. The repository retains a real-card regression that places this crest before field-card turn-end abilities.
entries.summary: 官网卡牌文字确认玛温纹章的回合结束触发；跨来源优先级由既有真实卡回归保留，当前官网未检出专门回答该组合的 Q&A。
